scope: Bounded transfer and planning of typed DXF GROUP objects into the writer.

behavior: The adapter ownership-transfer API refuses more than DRW_Dictionary::kMaxEntries (100,000) GROUPs before reserving or moving them into the writer vector.
The GROUP handle planner independently refuses a vector above the same dictionary entry limit before walking group names, member handles, and remaps.
The focused API control verifies that over-limit adoption leaves all caller list nodes intact and the writer receives no groups; a one-group control verifies successful adoption and ownership return.

focused.coverage: Over-limit GROUP source preservation and in-limit ownership return; TABLE guard regression after the header rebuild.

limitations: The count ceiling is internal and aligned with DRW_Dictionary::kMaxEntries, not a format support claim.
Other writer staging and caller-state paths remain open; see the follow-up receipt for the vector-setter control.
next: Continue auditing other writer/import staging bounds, allocation-failure behavior, source lifetime and scoped concurrency.

followUp.finding: The public const-vector setGroups API copied caller data before the independent planner enforced the 100,000-entry ceiling.
followUp.fix: setGroups now checks the count first, copies accepted data into a temporary with failure capture, and records rejected input so a later plan refuses until corrected. Valid setter/adoption input clears the rejection state.
